Container.Name: strata
Container.Overview: Strata inference engine running Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B MoE) locally. Exposes OpenAI-compatible API at :8081/v1 and Anthropic-compatible API at :8081. Default model: Coder IQ1_M quant on the RTX 5060 Ti.
Container.Requires: NVIDIA Container Toolkit; RTX 5060 Ti (GPU-b50f8351-6281-76b6-ebe6-b16d2dcc1f36); Driver 580+

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Strata API port (OpenAI + Anthropic compatible at /v1)

Config.Name: Data Volume
Config.Description: Persistent store for model files, prepared pack, preset and API key.

Config.Name: MODEL
Config.Description: Strata model quant. coder family: IQ1_M only. unsloth family: UD-IQ4_XS, UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q5_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL. base: Q2_0, IQ2_XS, IQ3_XXS, IQ3_S. swift: IQ2_XS, IQ3_S.

Config.Name: FAMILY
Config.Description: Model family: coder (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Coder, 256 active experts, code-focused), unsloth (high-quality quants), swift (1.5 fine-tune), qwen (base)

Config.Name: API_KEY_FILE
Config.Description: Path inside container to the API key file. Key is in /mnt/user/appdata/strata/.api_key on the host.

Config.Name: PARALLEL
Config.Description: Max concurrent requests. 1 is fine for personal use; raise to 2-4 for agentic/multi-call workloads (costs memory).

Config.Name: CONTEXT
Config.Description: Context window. 32k balances memory vs capability for dev use. Max supported is 262k.

Config.Name: VISION
Config.Description: Enable image input (off/on/gpu/cpu). Downloads extra ~0.9 GB vision reader.

Config.Name: KV
Config.Description: KV cache format: int8 (default), q4_0 (half memory), k8v4, fp16
